subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: Should local avatar failures keep the current generic direct-route 404 while improving authenticated UI diagnostics, or should `/avatar/{agentId}` expose more specific failure statuses for oversized, missing, or rejected files?
rationale: The remaining useful change affects an authenticated local workspace file-serving path, where clearer UX competes with information-disclosure boundaries and compatibility for image fetches.

options.title: Improve UI Diagnostics Only
options.body: Keep direct image fetches generic, but use existing metadata reasons and UI surfaces to show clear oversized or missing-file guidance.

options.title: Expose Endpoint Errors
options.body: Return more specific statuses such as 413 or 400 from `/avatar/{agentId}` with focused security review and tests proving unsafe path details do not leak.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Avatar Contract
options.body: Handle this diagnostics choice in the broader Control UI avatar issue at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/41201 and close this issue only after that path is settled.

recommendation.title: Improve UI Diagnostics Only
recommendation.body: Keep direct image fetches generic, but use existing metadata reasons and UI surfaces to show clear oversized or missing-file guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: The most security-sensitive avatar file-serving and size-limit history traces to this owner path.
